lines.text: Welcome, Master.
Would you like some dessert?
What can I do for you?
I'm ready whenever you need me.
How has your day been?
If Cocoa or Soda gives you any trouble, please let me know.
Are you busy at the moment?
I'm always here, so don't hesitate to call me if you need a hand.
What kind of service can satisfy every customer?

I am confident that the service we provide at Maid Cafe is world-class.
We look forward to your visit when you have time.

Do you usually get enough rest day to day, Master?
I hope you can get some well-deserved rest on your day off.

Hello, my name is Ade,
and I'll be at your service.
We are always striving to provide you with better service, so please stay tuned.
I feel like I am making progress.
Hehe, I think I'm more capable of assisting you now, Master.
Oh my gosh! Is this for me?
Wait just a moment. Let me see if I can find something to give you in return.
Thank you for your kindness, Master. I appreciate it.
Thank you for taking care of me, Master.
I will repay you with the best service I can offer.
It's my honor to serve you, Master.
I won't let you down.
I'm here, Master.
Going this way.
Order received.
Let's take care of each other.
Just remain calm, like we always do.
Let's start cleaning, shall we?
Let me take a break.
I'll check it out and be right back.
I need a second.
Preparation complete, ready to serve.
I'll provide you with the best service.
It's the rush hour. Leave it to me!
One down.
Is it over?
All clear.
Ahh!
Gah!
Ow...
I'm sorry, Master.
Are you satisfied with my service?
